title: Affine Angles via Area Cross Ratio and Isoptic Hyperbolas
summary: Affine geometry is usually regarded as a framework in which metric notions such as distance and angle are absent. However, just as projective geometry produces various metric geometries by introducing additional structures on the line at infinity, affine geometry can also serve as a natural basis for an angular geometry once certain directions at infinity are fixed. In this paper we introduce an affine angle determined by two fixed directions on the line at infinity and defined via an area cross ratio. This quantity is invariant under affine transformations preserving the chosen directions.…
